verdict.rationale: SumUp documents an official @sumup/sdk JavaScript package that wraps the SumUp API, ships TypeScript declarations, runs on Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel, and includes a checkout code example. Its in-person docs also list Reader SDKs for embedding payments in Android and iOS apps. Missing for 10: evidence of official server SDKs in languages beyond JavaScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
